==Syntax==
 unit [[switchMove]] move (Table code: "Usage:'''s'''")
 unit [[playMove]] move (Table code: "Usage:'''p'''")

* unit = [[Object]]: unit that perform this move
* move = [[String]]: name of move to be performed

The general naming convention for animation titles are explained on the '''[[AnimationTitles]]''' page.

A tool for previewing the moves (to make documenting them easier) is available {{Link|http://www.kronzky.info/animationviewer/|here}}.
